question: What extent of dominion results from the fortune of such accomplished beings?
premises: The beings described possess extraordinary fortune.
The three worlds constitute the totality of realms.
All these realms become subject to their control.
inference: Supreme fortune confers complete dominion over all three worlds.
uncertainties: The specific identity of teṣām relies on the preceding context.
plain_english: Oh, the fortune of them! All the three worlds are entirely under their control.
